summary: Datavault AI Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with Streeterville Capital, an accredited investor, closing on August 18, 2026. The company issued a $25,030,000 unsecured convertible promissory note (purchased for $25,000,000) and 15,000,000 pre-delivery common shares for $1,500, with an option for the investor to purchase up to $25,000,000 in additional notes. Proceeds are general corporate funding. The filing is a financing transaction, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisors, or deal terms typical of M&A are present.
